surfaces.name: Identity ASP.NET Core API
surfaces.control: OIDC code plus PKCE, server-bound request context, antiforgery, secure cookies, fixed-window rate limits, purpose-bound step-up, session rotation, neutral errors, privacy-safe own-session inventory, CAS revocation and actor-serialized batch revocation both excluding and including current, an idempotent organization bootstrap, one-shot co-owner invitations and last-owner-safe co-owner removal that derive actor and tenant server-side.
surfaces.gate: Integrated-local only; external OIDC and shared delivery remain NO-GO until RS-005 passes.

surfaces.name: Identity Next.js web flow
surfaces.control: Server-mediated authentication flow exposes loading, conflict, forbidden, provider-down and retry states without storing provider secrets or tokens in browser storage.
surfaces.gate: Integrated-local only; CSP and shared edge behavior remain NO-GO under RS-006.

surfaces.name: Identity PostgreSQL persistence
surfaces.control: EF Core migrations, optimistic concurrency, transactional journal/outbox, privacy-safe own-session inventory, individual, current, other-session and global revocation serialized by one actor lock with current revalidated before target locks, and rollback across every target journal, CreateOrganization, one-shot co-owner invitations and last-owner-safe co-owner removal are exercised against real local PostgreSQL. Identity platform operations use actor/session/version-bound SECURITY DEFINER functions without exposing token hashes; tenant mutations use split privilege roles, actor-bound SET LOCAL context and FORCE RLS with A/B/no-context/pool/job negative tests.
surfaces.gate: CreateOrganization, owner invitations and co-owner removal tenancy/RLS are integrated locally. Managed credentials, shared PostgreSQL, migrator execution, delivery workers and tenant isolation for every later module remain NO-GO.

surfaces.name: Synthetic identity provider
surfaces.control: Synthetic provider routes are registered only in Development/Test and production-like environments fail closed without approved OIDC configuration.
surfaces.gate: Must remain Development/Test-only; any registration in another environment blocks release.

surfaces.name: External OIDC provider and lifecycle
surfaces.control: Provider adapter and sandbox gate are specified; no external account, credential, region or contract is treated as approved.
tests: Recovery, factor loss, revocation and provider-outage scenarios
surfaces.gate: NO-GO until sandbox callbacks and lifecycle pass and region, DPA, retention, subprocessors, plan, SLA and exportability are approved.

surfaces.name: Shared hosting, edge and telemetry backend
surfaces.control: Local OpenTelemetry emission and delivery security requirements are specified without inventing a collector, edge or provider.
tests: CSP, cache-isolation, secret-canary and provider-outage tests
surfaces.gate: NO-GO until hosting/collector region, access, DPA, retention, CSP, edge isolation and redaction are verified end-to-end.

surfaces.name: Locked product dependency graph
surfaces.control: NuGet and pnpm dependency graphs are locked for API, Identity, tests, architecture fitness and web.
surfaces.gate: Local reproducibility only; CI identity, protected review, SBOM, provenance, signing and artifact registry remain NO-GO.

surfaces.name: CI and release artifact chain
surfaces.control: Required CI security gates are documented; absence is explicit and cannot be substituted by local lockfiles.
surfaces.gate: NO-GO for release promotion until a least-privilege CI identity and immutable signed artifact chain enforce every required gate.

surfaces.name: Territory authenticated API, web flow and local official snapshot
surfaces.control: Authenticated GET search/resolve endpoints use strict bounded inputs and response contracts, per-session rate limiting and no-store headers. Search reads an immutable active local snapshot of the 23 provinces plus CABA under least-privilege roles and FORCE RLS. Explicit coordinate resolution calls only the fixed Georef v2.0 adapter; exact coordinates are never written to PostgreSQL, journal, browser storage or application logs and exist only in a bounded volatile in-process cache. Provider failure returns labelled stale data or unavailable with manual local search fallback.
surfaces.gate: GO only for the integrated-local official snapshot, authenticated UI and local adapter verification with literal synthetic responses while egress remains disabled by default. Shared hosting, managed database, query-string redaction at every proxy/collector and any real external Georef traffic remain NO-GO under RS-006 and RS-010.

surfaces.name: External Georef v2.0 coordinate resolution provider
surfaces.control: The local adapter is pinned to https://apis.datos.gob.ar/georef/api/v2.0/, disables redirects, cookies and automatic decompression, applies a five-second timeout and 256 KiB response limit, and strictly validates JSON shape and official codes. Requests contain only the explicit latitude/longitude required for resolution; no tenant, field name or parcel geometry is sent, persisted or application-logged.
surfaces.gate: NO-GO for external Georef use until terms/licence, attribution, region, DPA, retention, subprocessors, SLA, quota/capacity, managed egress and end-to-end URL/query redaction are approved and verified. Passing local adapter tests does not approve the provider.

surfaces.name: Productive Core non-spatial field API and PostgreSQL persistence
surfaces.control: Authenticated owner-only GET/POST/PATCH field endpoints create, read and rename tenant-confidential non-spatial drafts without coordinates, area or geometry. The server derives actor, organization, unit type and states; mutations require antiforgery and versioned HMAC idempotency keys, while rename additionally requires a strong If-Match and returns neutral 412 on a stale new attempt. A narrow Identity SECURITY DEFINER port revalidates the live session and active owner membership before lookup/replay, then Productive Core uses NOLOGIN/NOINHERIT/NOBYPASSRLS roles, transaction-local actor/organization/session/authorization context, FORCE RLS, atomic unit+ledger+aliases+journal+typed outbox writes, append-only journal and neutral not-available errors. ManagementUnitDisplayNameChanged excludes both names and all actor/idempotency material. Telemetry is allow-listed to operation, outcome and bounded result count and excludes field name, organization/resource UUID, session and idempotency material.
surfaces.gate: GO only for the integrated-local non-spatial draft field slice. Geometry, area, tiles, spatial history, non-owner roles, external delivery, managed credentials/database/backup, shared hosting and production remain NO-GO; local tests do not approve those capabilities.

surfaces.name: Catalog authenticated read and platform editorial mutation API
surfaces.control: All routes require session authentication. Staging diff and mutations require separately provisioned platform editorial permission; mutations also require antiforgery. Catalog API v2 requires a reviewed candidateHash bound to active baseline and complete selected source snapshots. Publication/rollback serialize activation, preserve immutable provenance and atomically write audit plus local outbox. Historical search/detail and bounded version discovery expose unavailable legacy lineage explicitly; no specialized capability or professional acceptance is implied. No idempotency ledger or external delivery is claimed. CatalogEntryRef v1 is currently a platform-only application port consumed by Productive Core through API composition; integrations remains a planned consumer in the architecture map, not implemented runtime evidence.
surfaces.gate: Local Catalog v2 storage, HTTP and reader/browser gates passed at checkpoint 8f25ed6; current cycle-authority port verification remains pending. CAT-001/002 remain incomplete: segregated editorial approval workflow, audited replay of legacy unverified snapshots, national baseline professional approval and real-source operation remain unresolved. The discovery national candidate is not promoted by this local delivery.

surfaces.name: Weather tenant measurements/rules and global forecast/alert data
surfaces.control: Tenant endpoint filter revalidates live owner/session/resource; writes require antiforgery. Tenant rain/rules use FORCE RLS and a restricted runtime role, while global cache/alerts are separated. Alert ingestion requires separate platform permission. Missing configured rules/thresholds produce explicit insufficient_data abstention instead of invented defaults.
surfaces.gate: Partial only: exact CAP polygon/lifecycle and official provenance, safe provider egress/freshness guarantees, client-coordinate provenance, rule professional approval, UI, shared credentials and operation remain unresolved. Unit abstention tests do not prove database isolation.

surfaces.name: Additional Productive Core archive, cycles and geometry surfaces
surfaces.control: Archive uses a distinct ManagementUnitArchived contract. Cycles require live owner/resource authorization and tenant storage context. Initial geometry accepts only boundary and declared area; server PostGIS validates topology and generates spheroidal area/centroid. FORCE RLS protects an immutable typed snapshot; narrow transition checks and deferred integrity bind field, snapshot, journal and ManagementUnitGeometryConfigured event. Geometry GET reconciles ambiguous writes; no idempotency ledger or automatic retry. Neither geometry validation nor declared-area difference certifies cadastral status, official containment or agronomic suitability. Productive API v2 cycle creation resolves CatalogEntryRef through an API-composed public application port after owner/field authorization. A single Catalog MVCC snapshot checks the optional expected active version before item lookup; the reference is frozen, not guaranteed active at cycle commit. New rows require coherent references, while old metadata stays legacy_unresolved without backfill. Stored support labels never grant specialized capabilities; effective support is generic. Historical cycle reads do not query Catalog.
surfaces.gate: Initial geometry PostgreSQL/HTTP verification passed in the 2026-09-04 integrated 521-test backend gate with isolated PostGIS 3.6.2: no failures or skips. Geometry replacement/effective history, map/form accessibility, authoritative territorial containment and tolerance/overlap policy remain incomplete. Authoritative cycle-reference implementation verification is pending for this v2 delivery. Cycle event journal/outbox/idempotency, outputs/costs/documents, full productive UI and certified baseline coverage remain incomplete. Writer N-1 must stop before migration because new inserts require a snapshot; coordinated rollout is mandatory. Register membership is not a completed parent task or released capability.
